nodes.name: 01-RESEARCH.md
nodes.summary: Research notes analyzing the redundant `roomIcons` mapping in src/db/room.tsx, tracing its usage to InvoiceEditor.tsx, and recommending removal in favor of a single standardized icon since other room components (RoomManager, ReservationMap, InvoiceMap) already avoid it.

nodes.name: 04-PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 4 (Dynamic Room Integration refinement), detailing tasks to remove the static roomIcons mapping, standardize the room selection UI in InvoiceEditor with a single icon, finalize elimination of static room data, and verify the build with tsc.

nodes.name: 04-SUMMARY.md
nodes.summary: Completion summary for Phase 4, confirming removal of the roomIcons mapping and src/db/staticdata.ts, standardization of InvoiceEditor's room selection icons, and full transition to dynamic backend-driven room data via the listRoom API.
